findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
The following equipment is observed to be in need of repair: 

1. THIRD REPEAT- The deli/bakery walk-in cooler is observed to have ice accumulation on the ground and coming from the fan units. Ensure that the issue causing the ice build-up is repaired and that all the ice is scraped off to allow the floor to be smooth and easily cleanable. Due to this being a third repeat violation, a follow up is scheduled for 7/13/2026 to ensure that this violation is corrected. 

2. The shelf closest to the door on the left side of the deli walk-in cooler is observed to be significantly rusted on the bottom shelf. Ensure that this shelf is repaired or replaced to prevent contamination to food from rust. 

Ensure that equipment is maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment:
The following plumbing systems are in need of repair: 

1. There is a leak coming from the kitchen triple sink’s left faucet. 
2. There is a leak coming from the handles of the faucet of the kitchen handwashing sink. 

Ensure that these leaks are repaired. Plumbing systems should be maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The hood baffles. 
2. SECOND REPEAT- The floor under the fryers in the kitchen of the deli is observed to have an accumulation of grease and food debris on them. Ensure that these floors are being regularly cleaned to prevent the accumulation of soil residues. 
3. The wall and baseboard under the kitchen triple sink. 
4. The dish shelves to the right of the kitchen triple sink. 
5. The floor to the right of and behind the Henny Penny in the kitchen of the deli. 

Ensure that physical facilities are being cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There were no paper towels observed to be at the handwashing sink in the kitchen of the deli area. CORRECTED- Paper towels were provided at this sink during the inspection. Discussed this with the PIC. Ensure that there are always paper towels at all handwashing sinks to allow for proper use of a barrier while turning off faucet during handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There was a bucket of used mop water that had a mop still in it observed to be in the deli area. Ensure that after use, mops are always hung to dry and the mop water is dumped. Used mop water can attract pests.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: There was a sponge inside the handwashing sink that is located inside the deli kitchen area. Ensure that handwashing sinks are always accessible for employee use and are ONLY used for the intended purpose of handwashing. CORRECTED- The sponge was moved out of the handwashing sink and employees were educated. 

 (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: FIRST REPEAT: The knife holder in the front deli area next to the slicers is observed with food debris on the outside and the bottom of the container. The knife holder next to the mixing station is observed to have food debris on the bottom of the container. Ensure that the knife holder is cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 

 (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: At the start of the inspection, the sanitizer bucket was tested and recorded at 0ppm QUAT. The QUAT dispenser at the triple sink was tested and recorded at 200ppm. The sanitizer bucket was removed from service and remade with a fresh sanitizer solution and recorded at 200ppm. Ensure that the sanitizer bucket is tested and changed at a frequency necessary to maintain its efficacy.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The tile floor in the kitchen is observed to be in a state of major disrepair in the kitchen area. There are observed floor tiles cracked, broken, missing pieces, and areas with low to no grout present. The tile floor, according to the PIC, has been addressed with a work order having been placed. Ensure these floor tiles and grout areas are repaired/replaced to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface that prevents the accumulation of food debris and water. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

This is a repeat violation from the 8/7/23 inspection and the facility will be receiving a letter documenting the violation. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
